vb_textbox.text: I started by selecting each colour hat available, and seeing in each pairing which gave a higher amount. I quickly established two colours out of the four which consistently scored higher, and stuck to those two colours, until I started scoring below 3. When I did, I switched colours for that round only. For example, if I started with purple and blue on each round, then blue scored low, I would play purple and green until purple started scoring low, then switch to pink and green. Over the game play, the higher scoring one of each pair would switch, and I kept switching with it. Basically, if you score low, assume the other colour is now higher scoring, and switch back every time you get a low score, and repeat which 2 of the four colours are your current 'good' colours so you can quickly spot them in each round. Best of luck to you! :)
